summary: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K disclosing two items. On November 2, 2026, the board authorized a 2026 repurchase program of up to $1.0 billion of common stock, executed via open-market, Rule 10b5-1 plans, or privately negotiated transactions under Rule 10b-18. Management anticipates roughly $500 million of repurchases by year-end 2026 and the balance in 2027; the program has no expiration and no obligation. Separately, Chief Commercialization Officer Tolga Tanguler departs in December 2026. Watch pacing of buybacks against liquidity and the commercial leadership transition.
